title: Workspace audits have no record-free read-only mode
description: Evidence: runCommand records operations for requiresWorkspace commands except hard-coded exclusions, and prime itself requires a workspace; read-only inspection commands can still dirty operations/generated artifacts. Impact: operator requests like read-only or do not create bwrk records cannot safely use most Boreal inspection commands without leaving audit traces.
acceptanceCriteria: Approved read-only commands support an explicit record-free mode such as --no-operation-log or BOREAL_READONLY_NO_RECORD=1.
The mode fails closed for commands that would mutate runtime/generated artifacts and docs list which inspections are truly record-free.
